hikes.name: Mount Constitution from Mountain Lake
hikes.blurb: Up from a lake on Orcas Island to a stone tower on the islands' highest point, Baker rising over the water.

hikes.name: Turtleback Mountain
hikes.blurb: Up an Orcas ridge of grassy balds and oaks to Ship Peak's view over the western islands.

hikes.name: Lighthouse Point
hikes.blurb: Along the shore from Bowman Bay to rocky headlands with views of the pass and the islands.

hikes.name: Ebey's Landing Bluff Trail
hikes.blurb: Along a high bluff over the Strait, the Olympics across the water, back along the beach below.

hikes.name: Mount Erie
hikes.blurb: Through the Anacortes Community Forest to a rock summit over Lake Campbell and the islands.

hikes.name: Lime Kiln Point
hikes.blurb: A shoreline path to a lighthouse on San Juan Island, one of the best places to watch orcas from land.

hikes.name: Mount Finlayson
hikes.blurb: An open prairie ridge on San Juan Island's south end with the Olympics across the Strait.

hikes.name: Iceberg Point
hikes.blurb: A grassy, wind-sculpted headland on Lopez Island's south shore.

hikes.name: Goose Rock at Deception Pass
hikes.blurb: Under the Deception Pass bridge and up to a rocky bald over the churning channel.

hikes.name: Devils Slide
hikes.blurb: From Baker Preserve, a 4.7-mile round trip to Devils Slide, with about 1,250 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mud Lake
hikes.blurb: From Pine and Cedar Trailhead Parking, a 7.7-mile round trip to Mud Lake, with about 2,400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Chuckanut Falls
hikes.blurb: From Interurban Trail Parking, a 2.2-mile round trip to Chuckanut Falls, with about 450 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Cyrus Gates Overlook
hikes.blurb: From Fragrance Lake Trailhead, a 5.4-mile round trip to Cyrus Gates Overlook, with about 1,850 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Raptor Ridge Viewpoint
hikes.blurb: From Pine and Cedar Trailhead Parking, a 4.7-mile round trip to Raptor Ridge Viewpoint, with about 1,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Oyster Dome
hikes.blurb: From Blanchard Forest Upper Trailhead, a 5.2-mile round trip to the Oyster Dome viewpoint, with about 1,450 feet of climbing.
